name: openweb
description: A peer-to-peer web with no ads, no trackers, and no AI slop.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/index/dist/engine.test.js packages/index/dist/sqlite.test.js packages/core/dist/directory.test.js packages/builder/dist/builder.test.js
scripts.bench: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js bench
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @openweb/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @openweb/desktop
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run package:dir -w @openweb/desktop
